stories.headline: Global stocks hit longest losing streak since 2023 as AI trade unravels
stories.summary: World equities extended declines for a seventh straight session, the longest losing run since 2023, as a selloff in AI-related stocks spread into metals and broader markets. The unraveling AI trade is putting broader equity gains at risk and roiling commodity markets alongside it.

stories.headline: Anthropic shares tumble more than 10% in second day of trading after record IPO
stories.summary: Anthropic's blockbuster IPO, which saw unprecedented demand from retail and institutional investors, is becoming a catalyst for a savage selloff across AI stocks as shares dropped over 10% on their second trading day. Investors remain worried about AI valuations even after the first public debut of a frontier AI lab.

stories.headline: Emerging market stocks near bear market as tech-led rout extends to seventh day
stories.summary: An emerging-market equity index is on the cusp of a bear market after extending declines for a seventh consecutive day, driven by the AI-led tech selloff. The slide underscores how the unwinding of AI enthusiasm is spreading well beyond US megacap tech into global risk assets.

stories.headline: Copper sinks to lowest since March as AI selloff spreads to metals
stories.summary: Copper prices fell to their lowest level since March after a turbulent week in markets, as traders anticipate weakening industrial demand tied to the AI sector slump. The move highlights how the AI-driven risk-off mood is now wreaking havoc across commodity markets, not just equities.

stories.headline: Nvidia turmoil leaves few winners as Jensen Huang's ouster roils stocks
stories.summary: Jensen Huang's ouster from Nvidia has rattled markets, leaving a sea of losers with few identifiable winners as the stock turmoil extends across the chipmaking and AI ecosystem. The episode adds to the broader unwinding of AI-related trades this week.

stories.headline: Short-dated Treasury yields post biggest drop since 2025 on AI-driven haven demand
stories.summary: Two-year Treasury yields sank the most since 2025 as investors piled into short-dated government debt amid AI-related market turmoil, putting short bonds on pace for their best week in over a year. The move reflects growing risk-off positioning tied to the equity selloff.

stories.headline: SpaceX completes $32 billion AI chip debt sale at yields topping 8%
stories.summary: SpaceX finalized a debt deal to fund AI chip access, pricing at yields above 8%, which could serve as a blueprint for similar costly financing structures across the industry. The high borrowing cost underscores investor caution around AI infrastructure financing even as demand for compute remains strong.

stories.headline: Oil heads for third straight weekly decline on risk of renewed US strikes
stories.summary: Crude oil is on track for its third consecutive weekly drop as traders weigh the risk of renewed US military strikes alongside softening demand signals. Separately, Saudi Arabia struck a deal with Japan to help replenish depleted Japanese crude stockpiles and expand storage capacity.
